headline: Your month to go first
body: The Sun enters your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles your physical presence, your body, and how you enter a room. Vitality returns here for the next few weeks, and people notice you before you speak. This is the window to start what you've been circling: the project, the move, the introduction. Old versions of yourself are falling away fast; let them go without a eulogy. The one caution is taking up all the space: being so high-energy or assertive that people who process more slowly feel run over, ignored, or forced to agree just to avoid a scene. Shine bright, but don't burn the people closest to you.

headline: Ask for the real number
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your possessions, the price you put on your own work. Money gets your attention while it's here, and the attention pays: this is the month to actually open the savings account, cancel the subscriptions you forgot about, and ask for the raise with the figure written down in advance. It's also a check on what you value, because how you spend is a record of what you think matters, so fund the course, the trip, the cause you keep calling a priority. The one caution is letting your bank balance stand in for your worth, because a slow month does not make you less capable. Price the work with confidence and let the rest follow.

headline: Say it while words cooperate
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: messages, errands, siblings, the ten blocks around your home. Your curiosity wakes up while it's here, and so does your voice: sentences come out cleaner, questions come faster, and the class or book you've been meaning to get to suddenly holds your attention. Use the window to write the essay, send the pitch, or have the conversation with a sibling that keeps getting bumped. Even the errands go better when you treat them as a tour of your own neighborhood. The one caution is scattering, because a mind this busy will start five threads and finish none. Pick the two conversations that matter most and see them through.

headline: Go home and look around
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything underneath your public life. Your attention turns inward while it's here, toward the apartment, the parents, the question of where you actually come from. Energy for the domestic backlog shows up on its own: the repair, the rearranging, the drawer that has needed an hour of attention for a year. It's also the right window for family, because the conversations that usually stall have more light on them now, including the old tension nobody names. Name it gently. The one caution is mistaking withdrawal for rest, because hiding at home to avoid your life is not the same as recharging in it. Fix the foundation, then come back out.

headline: Do it for the fun of it
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles play: romance, art, games, kids, anything you do purely because you enjoy it. This is the Sun's favorite territory, and you'll feel it as appetite: for the date, the stage, the paint, the joke that goes slightly too far in the good way. Make something while the making is easy, and let it be seen: the drawings, the writing, the songs you'd normally keep in a drawer deserve an audience this month. If you're dating, plan the kind of night you'd enjoy retelling. The one caution is performing for a handclap until you forget what you liked about the thing, because approval is a bonus, not the point. Play like the score doesn't count and watch how good you get.

headline: Fix the week, keep the life
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the everyday machine: your schedule, your workload, your body's maintenance. Details get easier to see while it's here, which is why this is the classic month for the checkup you keep rescheduling, the inbox cleanout, and the routine you've meant to rebuild since January. Start with one habit and attach it to something you already do; changes made now tend to hold because you finally have the energy for them. Work goes well too, and the careful kind gets noticed. The one caution is turning improvement into self-criticism, because a better schedule should serve you, not grade you. Tune the machine, then go live the life it's for.

headline: Turn toward the other chair
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your closest friend, the name next to yours on the contract. Your attention naturally swings toward them while it's here, and so does everyone else's attention toward your relationships, which is why couples get asked about plans this month and single people get introduced. Use the light: have the conversation about where this is going, rebalance who does what, or make the collaboration official. You'll see the other side of an argument more clearly than usual, so negotiate now. The one caution is dimming yourself so the partnership photographs well, because you're half of what makes it work. Show up as a whole person and meet one.

headline: Nothing shared stays vague now
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what's shared: joint money, sex, secrets, everything two people hold together. Light in this house feels different, because it shines on things you usually manage in the dark: the loan, the will, the conversation about who owes whom what. Have those conversations now, while you have the clarity for them; the numbers are less frightening written down than circling your head at 2am. Closeness deepens too, if you let someone see the version of you without the presentation. The one caution is using what you learn about people as leverage, because secrets given in trust are not tools for winning arguments. Open the books, tell the truth, and keep what you're told.

headline: Curiosity wants a bigger map
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the far side of things: travel, study, belief, everything past your usual perimeter. Restlessness rises while it's here, and it's the useful kind, the kind that books the flight, downloads the syllabus, or finally opens the book that's been staring at you. Say yes to distance in whatever size you can afford, because even a day trip resets a mind that's been running the same loop. Big questions feel workable now too: what you believe, what your life is for, whether the plan is yours or inherited. The one caution is turning fresh conviction into a sermon, because you just learned this yourself. Explore first, conclude later, and let people catch up on their own.

headline: The spotlight found your job title
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in public: career, reputation, the work strangers know you by. Visibility runs high here: bosses notice, clients remember, and whatever you do gets seen by more people than usual. So do the visible thing: volunteer for the presentation, publish the work, ask for the title while the decision makers are already looking your way. It's also the month to check whether the ladder you're climbing leans against the right wall, because years of effort aimed at the wrong career don't come back. The one caution is cutting corners in front of everyone, since attention magnifies mistakes as reliably as wins. Do the work as if it's being watched, because it is.

headline: Round up your people this month
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes with your name on the sign-up sheet. You have more energy for people while it's here, and they can tell: invitations multiply, old friends resurface, and the group project finally moves the week you show up. Use it on purpose: organize the dinner, join the club you've been eyeing, give an hour to the cause you keep reposting. It's also the month to say your long-term hopes out loud, because the right friend can turn one from a wish into a plan. The one caution is steering by the group's applause, since consensus is comfortable and sometimes wrong. Belong fully, and keep your own direction.

headline: Rest now, launch later
body: The Sun is spending the next few weeks in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Your energy turns inward here, and fighting that is the main mistake people make with this transit, so let the calendar thin out on purpose. Sleep more, finish what's already open, and let the roles that have run their course end without launching replacements. Old feelings tend to surface in the quiet, which makes this a strong month for therapy, journaling, or long walks with the phone on silent. The one caution is confusing retreat with disappearing, because a month of canceled plans leaves you lonely rather than rested. Keep two people close and treat rest as the month's real assignment.

headline: Wear the mood, don't obey it
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles your body, your mood, and the face people meet first. Feelings sit closer to the surface than usual, and everyone can see them, so don't bother pretending you're fine when you're not. Use the sensitivity: notice what you actually want before the week decides for you. Just don't make permanent decisions from a passing mood, because this weather moves on in a day or two. Feel it fully, name it, and let it move through.

headline: Comfort is cheaper than the cart
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles money, possessions, and your sense of what you're worth. Feelings and finances get tangled for a day or two: you might crave comfort purchases, or feel richer or poorer than the numbers actually say, so check the balance before you decide anything about your finances. If you want to spend, buy something small and physical that makes ordinary life nicer, a candle, good coffee, the better socks. Just don't shop to fix a feeling, because the feeling comes back and the charge stays. Money and mood will both make more sense by the weekend.

headline: The words want out today
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles words, errands, siblings, and the neighborhood. Your feelings want to be spoken now, and the phone knows it: expect more texts going out and coming in, and conversations that go one layer deeper than usual. Call the sibling. Say the kind thing while you're thinking it. Errands and small talk both go easier when you stop rushing them. Just don't send the emotional essay at midnight, because tomorrow's version of you may want an edit. Talk plenty, and save the biggest sentences for daylight.

headline: Home wins the next two nights
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and where you come from. This is the Moon's own territory, so the pull toward home runs strong: you'll want your own bed, your own cooking, the people who knew you before you had a resume. Give in to it. Cancel the optional plans, call your mother or the person who fills that role, and let the evening be quiet. Old memories may drift up while you're there; let them visit without redecorating the past. In a couple of days you'll come back out restored.

headline: Two days built for play
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles romance, art, play, and kids. Your feelings want an outlet now, not an analysis, so give them one: dance in the kitchen, sketch something bad on purpose, flirt a little, say yes to the spontaneous plan. If you have kids, follow their lead for an evening; they're fluent in exactly this energy. The mood is generous but dramatic, so enjoy the big feelings without signing anything in their name. Play now, and let the seriousness wait until this pass is over.

headline: Your body is taking messages
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles routines, work, and health. Your feelings show up in the body now: tension in the shoulders, appetite doing strange things, energy that tracks your stress level exactly. Listen to it. Drink the water, take the walk, go to bed an hour earlier, and tidy the one surface that's been bothering you, because small order calms you faster than big plans this week. Just don't fuss over every symptom, since a body under a moody sky exaggerates. Care for yourself plainly and the mood evens out.

headline: Company sounds better than usual
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles partnership: the person across the table, the one you call first. You'll feel your feelings through other people now, wanting company more than usual and reading the moods of whoever is closest. Use it for closeness: ask how they actually are and listen past the first answer. Small gestures count double for a couple of days. Just don't turn their mood into your responsibility, because you can sit with someone without carrying them. Be near your favorite people and let that be enough.

headline: Deep water, short visit
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles shared money, sex, secrets, and everything intense. Feelings run stronger than the situation seems to call for, and old material can surface: a jealousy you thought was retired, a debt that nags, a memory with weight on it. Don't be alarmed; this house simply feels at full volume. If something needs saying to a partner about money or trust, say it gently and once. Journaling works well now too. Let the intensity move through you without building a case out of it, and it passes in a day or two.

headline: Restlessness with a passport
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles travel, study, and belief. Restlessness sets in, the pleasant kind: you'll want new scenery, a new idea, anything but the usual loop. Feed it in small portions: the documentary, the long drive, the cuisine you can't pronounce, the chapter of something that stretches you. Big questions may float up too, about meaning and direction; enjoy them without needing answers by Friday. Just don't book the one-way ticket on a two-day mood. Wander a little, learn one new thing, and come home lighter.

headline: Feelings clocked in at work
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles career, reputation, and what people know you for. Your work life gets emotional briefly: praise feels bigger, criticism feels personal, and you may catch yourself wondering whether any of this is what you meant to become. That question is worth hearing, not solving today. Notice which parts of the job make you proud and which you only tolerate. Just don't quit, send the reply-all, or renegotiate anything major on a passing mood. Take notes now and make moves next week.

headline: Text the friend back first
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles friends, groups, and the causes you care about. You'll feel your people more than usual: the group chat pulls at you, an old friend crosses your mind for no reason, and belonging suddenly matters more than ambition. Act on the small pull: send the meme, make the plan, show up to the gathering even if you leave early. If a friendship has felt one-sided, you'll notice it now; note it kindly. Mostly, let yourself be one of the group; it recharges more than solitude would this week.

headline: Scheduled quiet, not a slump
body: The Moon is spending the next couple of days in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Your energy dips and your inner life gets loud: vivid dreams, stray sadness, a craving for a closed door and no plans. None of it is a problem; it's the chart's monthly exhale. Give yourself the quiet on purpose: the early night, the long shower, the notebook nobody reads. You don't owe anyone an explanation for two low-key days. When the Moon crosses into your 1st house, your energy comes back like a light switching on.

headline: Say it like you mean it
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles how you show up: your name, your voice, your first impressions. Your mind runs quicker than usual while he's here, and the words arrive on time for once: in meetings, on dates, in the small talk you'd normally dodge. People are listening, which makes this the right window to introduce yourself to the person you keep almost meeting, pitch the idea you've been sitting on in your own words, or update the bio that no longer sounds like you. Saying a plan out loud makes it real now, so say it. The one caution is doing all the talking, because a quick mind can crowd out slower ones. Ask a question, wait for the whole answer, and you'll be twice as convincing.

headline: Talk numbers out loud
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your bills, your sense of what you're worth. Money becomes something you can think clearly about while he's here, which is rarer than it sounds. The statements make sense, the budget finally cooperates, and the negotiation you've been dreading turns out to be a conversation you can actually have. Use the window: ask for the number you want, question the charge that never looked right, read the contract before anyone rushes you. Small fixes pay off too, the subscription you forgot, the invoice you never sent. Just don't let the math become the mirror, because what you earn was never a measurement of what you're worth. Get the money right and leave your value out of it.

headline: Your words find their timing
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the streets you know by heart. This is his home turf, so everything he governs runs faster and better: replies come back quickly, ideas arrive mid-walk, and the sentence you've been hunting for shows up while you're doing the dishes. Use the window to write the piece you keep composing in your head, send the email, and clear up the misunderstanding that's been sitting between you and your sibling since spring. Errands practically do themselves right now, so knock out the whole list. The one caution is scatter, because a mind this quick wants seventeen open tabs and finishes none of them. Pick the three conversations that matter most and give them your full attention. The rest can wait a week.

headline: Ask how the story really went
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. Your thoughts turn homeward while he's here: you're rereading the lease, pricing the repair, remembering calls you owe. Family conversations go deeper than usual now, which makes this the right window to ask your mother how the story actually went, or to say the thing that only ever gets half said at dinner. It's also a good few weeks for the practical side of home: paperwork, plans, the fix you've been researching for months. The only thing to watch is rehashing, because a busy mind loves to relitigate old arguments nobody can win anymore. Ask about the past to understand it, not to reopen it, and the conversations will give you more than they take.

headline: Flirt in complete sentences
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, flirting, the things you do just because you love them. Your playful side gets articulate while he's here. The banter is quicker, the captions are better, and the message you'd usually draft four times comes out right the first time. Use the window: send the flirty text, start the story you keep narrating in the shower, sign up for the class that sounds like play rather than work. If there are kids in your life, they'll notice you're more fun to talk to. The one caution is staying clever when the moment calls for sincere, because wit makes a great opener and a lousy hiding place. Say the unpolished true thing sometimes. That's the line that works.

headline: Fix the day, not everything
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health, the small print of ordinary life. Your eye for detail sharpens while he's here, and the mess you've been ignoring becomes impossible to unsee: the inbox, the calendar, the drawer of cables. Good. Use the window to book the checkup, untangle the schedule, and set up the system you'll actually follow, the one with three steps, not thirty. Work conversations go smoothly too, so ask the clarifying question you've been guessing around. The one caution is worry, because a mind tuned this finely can turn every twinge into an hour of searching symptoms at midnight. Let a doctor answer the medical questions and let the symptom list stay short. A better Tuesday is the whole project.

headline: Have the talk while it's easy
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. Conversation is the whole game while he's here, and it's going well: misunderstandings untangle faster, negotiations find their middle, and the other side of the argument suddenly makes a kind of sense. That makes this the right window for the talk you've been putting off, the one about chores or money or where this is going. If you need to mediate, sign, or renegotiate anything two-sided, do it now while both of you can actually hear each other. Just don't debate to win, because being right is cheap and being understood is the actual prize. Ask one more question than you want to. It changes everything.

headline: Say the unsayable thing gently
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, beds, secrets, passwords. Small talk stops working while he's here. You want the real conversation, the one about the joint account, the debt, the thing neither of you has said out loud, and for once the words for it are available. Use the window: untangle the taxes, ask the direct question about who pays for what, tell the person you trust the secret you've been carrying alone. Research helps too, since your mind is built for fine print right now. The one caution is turning insight into interrogation, because reading people this well can slide into digging through what they haven't offered. Let others open their own doors. What's shared freely is worth more than anything found.

headline: Follow the question somewhere new
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything past your usual horizon. Your curiosity gets ambitious while he's here. One idle question turns into three open tabs, and suddenly you're pricing flights at midnight. Follow it. This is the right window to enroll, book, apply, or start the book that's been staring at you, because big ideas come easier now and so do the words for them. Conversations with people who see the world differently will teach you the most, so seek them out on purpose. The one caution is preaching, because fresh conviction loves an audience more than it loves a dialogue. Hold your new ideas loosely enough to keep learning. That's what they're for.

headline: Put the pitch in writing
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. Your professional voice sharpens while he's here. The pitch organizes itself, the presentation stops fighting you, and in meetings you're the one who can say what everyone else is circling. Use the window: ask for the meeting, send the proposal, update the resume while you can describe your own work clearly. Talking to people above you goes better now too, so stop waiting to be noticed and introduce yourself. The only thing to watch is that your words carry further than usual here, including the careless ones, because anything said at work is on the record somewhere. Write the email like your boss's boss will read it. She might.

headline: Turn the group chat into plans
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes you show up for. Your social life gets talkative while he's here. Invitations multiply, old friends surface with news, and the group chat produces an actual plan for once. Use the window: organize the dinner, join the club you've been eyeing, volunteer for the cause you keep reposting. New people arrive through the ones you already know now, and one conversation with a stranger at a friend's table can redirect your whole year. The one caution is spreading your attention across everyone and giving it to no one, because fifty light exchanges don't add up to one real conversation. Pick the two friendships that matter and go deeper than the updates.

headline: Let the quiet finish its sentence
body: Mercury is spending the next few weeks in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Your mind goes inward while he's here, and your usual quickness seems to go missing: names escape you, meetings drain you, and the right words show up an hour after the conversation ends. Nothing is wrong. This is thinking done under the surface, and it's excellent at its job if you give it quiet: journal, take the long walk alone, write down the dream before it dissolves. You're allowed to be less available while that work happens. The one caution is treating every 3 a.m. thought as truth, because a mind this deep in the dark exaggerates. Write it down, read it at noon, and keep what survives daylight.

headline: Draft the new introduction first
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles how you show up: your name, your face, your first impressions. The version of yourself you've been presenting is up for review, and you can feel the seams: the bio sounds like someone else, the elevator pitch has gone stale, and people keep meeting a you that you didn't intend. This is a second pass, not a setback, so use it like an editor. Rewrite the bio, rehearse the introduction, and notice which parts of the old persona you've outgrown. People who knew an earlier you may resurface, and their version of you is useful information. Just don't launch the rebrand mid-retrograde, because whatever you announce now, you'll want to reword. Revise quietly for three weeks. Deliver the new you after.

headline: Chase the money you're owed
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your bills, your sense of what you're worth. Money paperwork wants a second look while he's backtracking, and it has earned one: the subscription that's been charging you since last year, the invoice nobody paid, the raise conversation that ended in 'let's revisit this.' Revisit it. This window is built for chasing refunds, renegotiating rates, and rereading anything before you sign it, twice if there are numbers in it. Income from an old source can even come back around, the former client, the deposit you forgot existed. The one caution is the big purchase, because what looks perfect this month tends to reveal its flaw next month. Repair your finances now and spend later; you'll come out ahead.

headline: Reread everything before you send
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, emails, errands, siblings. This is his own house, so the review runs deep and you'll notice it daily: messages arrive out of order, autocorrect gets creative, and the meaning you intended is not always the meaning received. It's not doom, it's a proofreading period. Reread before you send, confirm the time and the address, and say the important things twice in two different ways. It's also the right window to answer the messages you left hanging, and to restart the sibling conversation that ended in the wrong place. Just don't fire off the reply while you're annoyed, because this is exactly the month it goes to the wrong person. Slow words now save whole apologies later.

headline: Reopen the past to close it
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. Old family conversations circle back while he's backtracking: the story your relatives each tell differently, the decision about the house that never got made, the relative you've been meaning to call since winter. This is the window to have those talks again on purpose, because the second pass tends to go better than the first. Practical home matters want review too, so reread the lease, question the repair estimate, and double-check anything you sign about where you live. Memories may surface with opinions attached; let them inform you without running the whole week. Just don't reopen an old argument to win it this time. Reopen it to end it, and home gets quieter.

headline: The old flame is an audition
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the things you do just because you love them. The past gets flirtatious while he's backtracking. An old flame resurfaces in your messages, a half-finished story resurfaces in your drafts, and both deserve the same treatment: a clear-eyed second look before you dive back in. This is a strong window for revision, so reread the manuscript, rework the song, and pick up the hobby you dropped when life got serious. If the person from before comes around, ask what actually ended it, because retrograde returns are auditions, not reunions. The one caution is nostalgia's editing, since memory keeps the chemistry and deletes the reasons. Enjoy the replay, check it against the record, and keep whatever proves itself twice.

headline: Fix one system a week
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health, the systems that run your week. Expect the machinery to ask for maintenance: the calendar double-books itself, the printer picks a fight, and the routine that worked in March stops working now. That's the assignment. Review the systems rather than pushing through them: rebook the appointment, back up the files, rewrite the process document everyone ignores. Health follow-ups belong in this window too, the second opinion, the results you never called about, the prescription due for review. The one caution is blaming yourself for the friction, because a second pass is not a setback and a broken system is not a broken you. Fix one process a week for three weeks. That's the whole job.

headline: Renegotiate what you already agreed
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. Old conversations between the two of you come back for a second pass, which is the point: the chore split that quietly stopped being fair, the agreement you made in a different year, the argument that got dropped rather than resolved. Revisit them on purpose and the relationship comes out cleaner. Exes and former business partners have a way of reappearing now; hear them out if you want to, and ask what's different this time before anything restarts. Just don't sign new partnership terms mid-retrograde if you can wait, because the fine print isn't done changing. Repair the agreements you already have; the new ones can wait three weeks.

headline: Ask directly, skip the detective work
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, beds, secrets, passwords. The joint paperwork wants a second pass while he's backtracking, and it usually deserves one: the tax question you answered too quickly, the beneficiary form from two jobs ago, the debt plan that made sense before the rates changed. Review all of it and reset the passwords. Old intimacies can resurface too, a secret you're finally ready to say out loud, a conversation about trust that ended without an ending. Have it again; the second version tends to be more honest and less loud. The one caution is playing detective with someone else's privacy, because suspicion grows fastest in a review period. Ask directly for what you want to know. It works better than searching.

headline: Confirm the flights, revisit the beliefs
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything past your zip code. Plans made at a distance want confirming while he's backtracking, so recheck the flights, the visa dates, the booking that felt too smooth. Delays here are annoying, not ominous, and the rerouted trip has a history of turning into the better story. This is also the window to return to abandoned learning: the course you quit at module three, the language app you dropped in week two, the degree question you shelved. Old teachers and old ideas resurface with new relevance. The one caution is defending a belief just because it's yours, since the review applies to opinions too. Reread something that once changed your mind. See if it does again.

headline: Follow up on the old application
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. Professional threads from the past come back around while he's backtracking: the recruiter from last year, the former boss with an opening, the project everyone shelved that suddenly looks smart again. Follow up on all of it, because a second approach often succeeds where the first one didn't. It's also the window to revise the materials that speak for you, the resume, the portfolio, the website bio from three jobs ago. Just don't pick this month for the dramatic public announcement, because messages garble easily in this house right now and reputations are expensive to correct. Polish quietly and launch loudly later. The order matters more than the speed.

headline: Reunions work when they're easy
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes you show up for. Expect the past in your notifications: the college friend passing through town, the group that wants you back, the plan from last summer back asking for a second chance. Say yes to the reunions that feel easy, because friendships revisited now tend to pick up mid-sentence. Group logistics will need patience, since the chat will produce three conflicting dates before it produces one dinner, so confirm everything twice. It's also worth reviewing which circles fit the person you've become. The one caution is rejoining out of guilt, because an obligation with a friendly face is an obligation all the same. Keep the friends who feel like the present tense.

headline: Not every memory wants action
body: Mercury is retrograde for about three weeks in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This is the quietest review in the zodiac, and it happens mostly at night: old memories arrive uninvited, dreams get specific, and conversations from years ago replay with new subtitles. Nothing needs announcing. Journal what surfaces, reread the old entries, and let the pattern show you what it's been trying to say. Therapy and long walks do double duty in this window, and the apology never sent can finally get written, even if it's never mailed. The one caution is mistaking a memory for a message, because not everything that resurfaces is asking for action. Some of it just wants to be witnessed on its way out.

headline: Say yes while it's easy.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles how you show up: your face, your style, your first impressions. While she's here, you're simply easier to like, and you can feel it working: compliments land more often, conversations open by themselves, and the mirror is kinder than usual. Use the window: book the haircut, update the wardrobe, say yes to the invitations you'd normally think about for a week. It's also the right time for the kind of self-care that has nothing to do with appearance, the rest and movement that make you feel like yourself again. Just don't let polishing the surface replace actually showing up, because the charm people are responding to was never the outfit. It was you, relaxed enough to be seen.

headline: Charge what it's worth.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your things, your sense of what you're worth. Money tends to move while she's here, and it moves toward you: the raise gets approved, the client signs, the thing you've been trying to sell finally sells. That makes this the right window to ask for the number you actually want instead of the one you think they'll accept. Spend some of it on something that lasts, one good thing instead of ten small ones. The only thing to watch is comfort spending, because under this influence everything looks like a treat and the cart fills itself. Buy what you'll still love in a year and let the rest go.

headline: Send the text, read the fine print.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the neighborhood. Communication comes easier while she's here, and you'll notice it in small ways: replies come back warmer, the right sentence shows up on time, and even the daily errands feel more pleasant when you take the longer way. That ease makes this the right window to fix a misunderstanding with a sibling or a neighbor, or to finally write the thing you've been circling for weeks. The one caution is that everything sounds nicer than usual right now, including bad deals and pretty promises. Enjoy how charming the world has gotten, and read the fine print anyway.

headline: Home is the good part right now.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. While she's here, home is where you'll want to be: fixing the lighting, cooking for the people you love, staying in on a Friday without feeling like you're missing a thing. The ease reaches your family too. Conversations that usually take effort come more naturally now, which makes this the right window for the call you've been putting off or the visit that never quite happens. If old memories start surfacing, let them, but remember that nostalgia is a filter: the past usually looks softer than it actually felt. Spend these weeks making your home somewhere you love being.

headline: Take the fun seriously.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, flirting, the things you do purely because you love them. Joy comes easier here, and so does being noticed, which is why this transit has a reputation for good dates and better stories. If you're single, accept the invitations; if you're not, plan the night that feels like the early days. It's also the right window to pick back up whatever you dropped when life got serious, the painting, the dancing, the thing you used to do just for you. The only caution is overdoing it, because pleasure works best as a meal, not a binge. Enjoy everything, and leave some for next weekend.

headline: Make the dreaded part beautiful.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: your routines, your workspace, your health. She makes the ordinary parts of the day easier to enjoy, and small upgrades go a long way right now: the desk you actually like sitting at, the lunch that isn't sad, the walk that breaks the afternoon in half. Start with the part of your day you dread most, because that's where a little beauty pays the biggest return. Health habits started now tend to stick, since they begin from pleasure instead of punishment. Just don't turn self-care into another job; if the routine needs a spreadsheet, it stopped being care. Keep it small enough to enjoy.

headline: Have the talk while it's easy.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. This is her home turf, and relationships get their ease back while she's here. Compromise comes cheaper, affection returns to things that had gone practical, and the conversation your relationship has been waiting for goes better now than it would any other month. It's a classic window for making it official, celebrating something, or finally rebalancing who does what. If you're single, pay attention to who feels like an equal instead of a project. The only caution is agreeing your way into invisibility, because being easy to be with isn't the same as being known. Bring your actual preferences to the table; the harmony will hold.

headline: What you share gets sweeter.
body: Venus is spending a few weeks in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, beds, secrets, passwords. Closeness comes easier while she's here. What have you been carrying entirely on your own? The conversations about joint accounts, shared debts, or who pays for what are softer now, offering you a real opportunity for clarity and resolution. Money can even arrive through a partner or a joint venture. Over the coming weeks, use this supportive window to deepen your connections. Are you ready to ask for the commitment you deserve, consolidate the debt, or split a burden that was never yours to carry alone? If someone trusts you enough to show you the tender, vulnerable parts of themselves they usually keep hidden away, meet them with compassion. The one shadow is possessiveness: closeness this deep can slide into keeping score or keeping tabs. It works as long as you're both still individuals inside of the connection.

headline: See it up close.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything outside your zip code. Restlessness turns pleasant while she's here, and distance does you good, so book the trip even if it's only a day away. Learning gets its shine back too: classes, books, and teachers land differently now, and someone from a different background may become important, romantically or otherwise. Even your own beliefs relax, and conviction softens into curiosity. The one caution is falling for the postcard version of a place, a person, or an idea you've only seen from far away. Go look up close before you rearrange your life.

headline: Let them see the work.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. Being liked counts double at work while she's here, and doors open through charm that effort alone couldn't budge. That makes this the right window to ask for what you've been waiting to be handed: the title, the feature, the meeting with the person above your boss. Let the work look as good as it is, because your taste is part of your value here. The only caution is chasing a success that photographs well but doesn't feel like yours. Take the applause, and make sure the work still matches your values.

headline: Love arrives through friends.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes you show up for. Friendship comes easier while she's here, and new people tend to arrive through the ones you already know, which is also how love has a habit of showing up under this transit if you're single. Make the plan with the friend you keep meaning to see; the group says yes this month. It's also the right window to join the thing you've been eyeing: the club, the class, the cause. The only caution is becoming everyone's favorite and no one's confidant, because popularity isn't the same as belonging. Pick two people and go deeper.

headline: The closeness nobody posts about.
body: Venus is spending the next few weeks in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Affection goes quiet here, and you may find yourself craving the kind of closeness nobody posts about. Honor that: rest counts as romance this month, and the bath, the nap, and the day with your phone off will do more for you than any night out. Old patterns in love tend to surface under this transit, which makes it a good window for therapy, journaling, or any practice that reaches under the surface. If someone from the past drifts through your dreams, treat it as information, not instruction. The one caution is secrecy itself, because a connection that only exists in hiding isn't growing, it's just hidden. Give the private feeling one witness, even if it's a notebook.

headline: The makeover can wait six weeks
body: Venus is retrograde in your 1st house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles how you show up: your face, your style, your first impressions. This is a review of the way you present yourself, and it tends to arrive as doubt: the wardrobe suddenly looks wrong, the mirror gets critical, and people from your past reappear expecting the person you used to be. Use the window to figure out what you actually like, not what you were told suits you; go through the closet, revisit the old photos, and notice which versions of you were borrowed. Just don't book the dramatic haircut or the drastic style change while the doubt is loudest, because a second look is not a setback. The taste that survives these weeks is the one that was yours all along.

headline: Audit the money before adding to it
body: Venus is retrograde in your 2nd house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your spending, your sense of what you're worth. Money comes back for review here, and you'll see it in the details: the refund you forgot to chase, the subscription quietly charging you, the rate you set years ago and never updated. Use the window to audit rather than acquire; renegotiate the fee, reopen the raise conversation that got tabled, and notice where you've been underpricing yourself out of politeness. Just hold off on the big purchase, because retrograde taste is unreliable and the thing you covet now often looks different once Venus turns around. If you still want it when she goes direct, it was real; most of what tempts you now you won't even miss.

headline: Old conversations return for a better ending
body: Venus is retrograde in your 3rd house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the neighborhood. Conversations from the past reopen here, usually for a reason: the misunderstanding with your sibling that never actually got resolved, the message you sent too fast, the neighbor you've been avoiding since spring. This is the window to say your piece again, better; apologies go over well under this transit, and so do second drafts. Reread everything before you send it, and read anything you're asked to sign twice, because offers sound smoother than they are right now. The one caution is nostalgia in your inbox, since not every old thread deserves a reply. Answer the ones that come with repair attached, and archive the rest.

headline: Rearrange before you renovate
body: Venus is retrograde in your 4th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. The past gets loud in this house: old family stories resurface, relatives you'd drifted from reach out, and the childhood version of home starts looking better than it ever actually was. Use the window for repair, because conversations about old grievances go softer now than they have in years, and the relative you've been avoiding may be easier to reach than you think. At home itself, rearrange before you renovate; your taste is mid-revision, and the wall color you're sure about today may embarrass you by fall. Let the memories visit and take what's useful, remembering you're allowed to love where you came from without moving back in.

headline: Not every returning spark needs relighting
body: Venus is retrograde in your 5th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, flirting, the things you do purely because you love them. This is the classic transit for exes, and it often delivers: the text from the person you almost dated, the dream about the one who got away, the sudden urge to check if they're single. Treat the returns as review, not reunion; a few are unfinished business worth finishing, and the rest are proof of how far you've come. The better bet is the creative past, because the half-finished novel, the abandoned painting, and the hobby you dropped when life got serious all revive beautifully now. Just don't make grand declarations mid-retrograde, since what feels like fate in week two often feels like a rerun by week six.

headline: Refine the routine, don't replace it
body: Venus is retrograde in your 6th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: your routines, your work, the upkeep of your body. The habits you've stopped enjoying come up for review here, and the evidence is small but constant: the workout you dread, the lunch you eat without tasting, the workflow that made sense two jobs ago. Use the window to refine rather than overhaul; bring back the old habit that actually worked, the walk, the stretch, the early night, not a whole new program. Former coworkers and old clients tend to resurface now too, some carrying work worth taking. Just don't sign the year-long membership mid-retrograde, because commitments to routines made now rarely survive her turning direct. Adjust first, and let the commitment come later.

headline: Renegotiate the terms, keep the person
body: Venus is retrograde in your 7th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your closest ally, the one across the table. Relationships come up for renegotiation here, and the unspoken contracts surface first: who compromises, who plans, who has quietly been doing more than their share. Have that conversation, because repair goes unusually well under this transit and resentments named now tend to actually resolve. Exes and former partners often reappear too; treat them as information about your patterns before you treat them as options. The one thing to put off is making it official, the signing, the announcing, the moving in, because agreements struck mid-retrograde usually need redrafting. Review the partnership as it actually is, and the ones worth keeping will come through the review closer than before.

headline: Old debts surface so they can close
body: Venus is retrograde in your 8th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles what you share: joint money, debts, sex, the secrets only two people know. Old entanglements resurface here, usually with paperwork attached: the loan nobody mentions, the account you never closed after the breakup, the tax question you've been avoiding. Use the window to untangle rather than deepen; chase the refund, ask plainly who owes what, and finally separate your finances from someone you're no longer building with. Intimacy gets reflective too, and an old dynamic may replay so you can see it clearly this time. Just don't consolidate the debt or sign a new joint agreement mid-retrograde, because shared commitments made now tend to need renegotiating later. Closing something old, on paper or in person, is the win of these weeks.

headline: Go back before you go further
body: Venus is retrograde in your 9th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything outside your zip code. The pull here is backward and outward at once: the city you keep meaning to return to, the course you dropped two chapters in, the philosophy you abandoned when it stopped being convenient. Return trips go better than new ones now, and finishing an old certification or reading list beats enrolling in something shiny. Expect travel plans to revise themselves, so book the flexible fare and confirm the reservation twice. The deeper review is belief, because an idea you dismissed years ago may deserve a second reading now that you're someone else. Just don't convert to anything mid-retrograde; revisit first, and keep only what survives the return.

headline: Your history is doing the networking
body: Venus is retrograde in your 10th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people attach to you. The past comes calling professionally here: a former boss with an offer, an old client back with budget, a project you shipped years ago suddenly getting noticed again. Take those meetings, because doors reopen more easily than new ones open right now, and your track record speaks louder than any pitch. It's also the window to renegotiate what was set wrong the first time: the title, the rate, the credit you never got. Just hold the rebrand, because the new logo, headshot, or public announcement chosen mid-retrograde tends to age badly. Polish the portfolio for now, and save the relaunch for when Venus is moving forward again.

headline: Reunions beat introductions this month
body: Venus is retrograde in your 11th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes you show up for. Old friends resurface under this transit, and the good ones arrive like no time passed: the college roommate, the friend from the job before last, the group that dissolved for no real reason. Reach back, because reunions go better than new introductions right now, and a friendship worth reviving usually shows itself within the first conversation. The quieter work is reviewing what you belong to, since some group commitments have been running on autopilot for years. Just don't quit anything publicly mid-retrograde, because the frustration peaking now often softens once Venus turns direct. Step back quietly if you need to, and decide for real in six weeks.

headline: Let the past finish saying goodbye
body: Venus is retrograde in your 12th house for about six weeks, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This is the deepest version of the review, and it works underground: exes appear in dreams, old feelings surface without warning, and grief you thought was finished asks for one more pass. Let it happen on paper before it happens out loud, because journaling, therapy, and long walks alone do the sorting better than any 2am message could. Closure is the offer here, arriving quietly, often as the realization that you stopped missing someone. Just don't start anything secret mid-retrograde, since what begins in hiding now tends to stay hidden. Give the old feeling its ending, and you'll come out of these weeks lighter than you went in.

headline: All this fuel needs a direction.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles you: your body, your name, the first impression you make. Energy comes back with an edge while he's here. You wake up wanting things, the workouts finally happen, and the word no arrives on time for once. Use the window to start what needs a strong opening: the project, the training plan, the conversation where you say what you actually want. People will move aside for someone this decided, so decide. The one caution is the temper that comes with the fuel, because irritation this month goes from private to spoken very fast, and you'll be the one apologizing. Point the heat at a goal and it's a gift. Point it at people and it's a mess.

headline: Go earn it, then guard it.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: income, possessions, your price. Money becomes something you chase rather than wait for while he's here. You'll have the nerve to ask for the raise, invoice the client who's gone quiet, or finally start the side project that pays. Use the window: name the number you actually want, because this transit gives you the push negotiations usually lack. Selling unused possessions works too; so does canceling whatever quietly drains the account every month. Just don't let the same fire spend the money, because impulse buys under Mars feel like victories and arrive like regrets. Earn hard, then let the purchase wait a week. Whatever survives the week was worth it.

headline: Speak first, and mean it.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the daily rounds. Your sentences get faster and sharper while he's here, and the quiet observer role stops fitting; you'll want to say the thing, and mostly you should. Use the window for work that needs verbal nerve: the pitch, the hard email, the class that intimidated you, the writing project that needs a fighting spirit rather than a mood. Learning goes quickly now because you attack material rather than absorb it. The one caution is that everything sounds like a debate to you this month, including small talk, and being right starts costing you listeners. Win the arguments that matter and let the traffic, and the comment section, go.

headline: Fix the house, then the household.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything underneath you. The inertia around the house lifts while he's here: suddenly you're fixing the leak, clearing the garage, moving furniture at ten at night because it could not wait. Use the push, because domestic projects started now actually get finished. Just know that Mars heats the people in the house too, and the disagreement that's been simmering, about chores, parenting, or an old family grievance, tends to reach the surface now. That's not a disaster; some arguments are overdue, and this one goes better on purpose than by ambush. Pick the moment, say it plainly, and let the household run on truth for a while. Then go finish the garage.

headline: Make the first move already.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, games, the things you do because you want to. Desire stops being subtle while he's here. If you're single, you'll want to make the first move, and you should, because hesitation is the only thing this transit punishes. If you're partnered, plan something with adrenaline in it; the relationship remembers how to play. Creative work gets bolder too, so take the risk in the draft, the color, the key change you've been talking yourself out of. The one caution is competitiveness leaking into places built for joy, because a game you have to win stops being a game. Play hard, lose loudly, and flirt like the outcome doesn't scare you.

headline: The to-do list doesn't stand a chance.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily machinery: your work, your routines, your health. Procrastination mostly evaporates while he's here. The backlog that's been staring at you gets cleared in days, and the gym stops being theoretical, which makes this the right window to start the regimen you keep researching. Start it at half the intensity you're tempted to, because Mars here loves a heroic first week and a pulled muscle in the second. The other thing to watch is the workplace, where your patience for slow coworkers and pointless meetings drops to nothing; say what needs improving without turning it into a takedown. Point all of it at the task list and this becomes one of the most productive months you'll get all year.

headline: Honest beats polite this month.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. Wants get louder in your closest relationships while he's here, yours and theirs, and the polite version of the conversation stops working. Use that loudness. The negotiation you've been avoiding, about money, chores, commitment, or business terms, goes further now because you'll finally say the real number. Passion runs higher too, and a relationship that had gone administrative can remember it's a romance. The one caution is turning every difference into a contest, because Mars here wins arguments and loses evenings. Fight for the relationship, not against the person, and the friction turns into the most honest month you've had together.

headline: Push the paperwork, not the person.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: joint money, debts, sex, the private material. Things you've been avoiding in this territory stop being avoidable while he's here, and that's the gift. Use the window to chase what's owed: the reimbursement, the insurance claim, the tax question, the conversation about who pays for what. You'll have the nerve now, and these matters move when someone pushes. Intimacy intensifies too, and honesty in that department goes further than pretending. The one caution is control, because shared resources under Mars can turn into a fight about power wearing a spreadsheet as a disguise. Ask for transparency rather than surrender. What you two can look at together stops being a threat.

headline: Book it, study it, mean it.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything past your usual borders. Restlessness gets ambitious while he's here. The trip stops being a screenshot folder and becomes a booking, the course finally gets enrolled in, and the subject you've been circling becomes something you attack. Use the push for the version of learning that scares you a little, because this transit rewards the harder syllabus. Your opinions arrive with extra horsepower too, and you'll defend them well. The one caution is confusing conviction with volume, because a belief you can't be questioned on isn't a belief, it's a reflex. Argue to find out something, not to finish someone. Then book the flight.

headline: Aim the ambition, skip the mutiny.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the ladder. Ambition stops whispering while he's here. You'll want the bigger project, the title, the meeting where decisions get made, and the good news is that visible effort actually gets noticed under this transit. Use the window to make the move that requires nerve: pitch the initiative, apply above your level, have the salary conversation while your drive is doing the talking. Just don't spend the fire fighting your boss, because Mars here has a documented taste for battles with authority, and those wins tend to be expensive. Outwork the politics rather than joining them. What you build this month becomes what people say about you next year.

headline: Rally the group, don't run it alone.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, communities, the causes with your name on the sign-up sheet. Your social life gets a motor while he's here. You're the one organizing the trip, recruiting for the team, turning the group chat's someday plan into a date on the calendar. If a cause has been quietly bothering you, this is the window where you actually show up for it, and people follow someone that committed. The one caution is that leading and steamrolling feel identical from the inside, so keep asking the group what it wants; allies volunteer, they don't take orders. Push the mission, protect the friendships, and this becomes the month your people get things done together.

headline: Work quietly, rest on purpose.
body: Mars is spending the next several weeks in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Your drive goes underground while he's here, and pushing on the outside world can feel like running in sand. That isn't failure; the work has moved somewhere nobody can watch it. Use the window for what solitude is good at: finish the quiet project, do the therapy work, close the chapter you keep not closing. Old conflicts may resurface asking to be felt rather than reargued. The one caution is anger with no address, because irritation you don't name in this house leaks out sideways as exhaustion or snapping at the wrong person. Name what's actually bothering you, even just in a notebook. Rest is strategy this month, not retreat.

headline: Tune the engine before the race.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 1st house for a couple of months, which turns the engine of you inward for a service check. Motivation may run lower than usual, and pushes that normally work, at the gym, in negotiations, in plain assertiveness, get less traction. That's not a malfunction; it's the review. Use the pass to look at how you go after things: where you charge when you should ask, where you swallow anger and call it patience. An old fight about how you fight may resurface, and this time you can answer it differently. Refine the plan you were about to launch rather than launching it, and rebuild fitness gradually rather than dramatically. A second pass at yourself is not a setback. You come out of this knowing exactly what you want, which is the whole point of Mars.

headline: Collect what you're already owed.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 2nd house for a couple of months, sending money matters back for a second look. Earning may feel slower, which makes this the wrong window to force a raise and the right one to build the case for it: gather the numbers and document the wins, so the ask is ready when the push returns. Old money threads come back too, the unpaid invoice, the deposit you never chased, the subscription quietly billing you since last year. Chasing what you're already owed goes surprisingly well now. The one caution is frustration spending, buying something big just to feel movement, because purchases made to break a stall usually become the next stall. Review, collect, cancel, renegotiate. None of this is going backward; it's finding money that was yours all along.

headline: Draft twice, send once.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 3rd house for a couple of months, sending your words back through edit. Messages misfire more easily now, so the sharp reply benefits from an overnight draft, and anything important, contracts, forms, addresses, deserves a second read before you hit send. An old argument may circle back, with a sibling, a neighbor, someone from the daily rounds, and that's the actual assignment: this pass, you can resolve it rather than win it. It's also the right window to revise the writing you abandoned, resume the course you dropped, and get the car and the commute's machinery maintained before they insist. The one caution is arguing on autopilot, defending a position you quietly stopped holding. Check whether you mean it before you fight for it. Rewrites count as progress here.

headline: Finish what the house started.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 4th house for a couple of months, sending you back through unfinished business at home. The renovation that stalled, the half-painted wall, the repair you patched in a hurry: this is the window where they actually get completed, and finishing goes better than starting anything new under this influence. Family has a second pass coming too. A disagreement you thought was over may return, usually because it was paused rather than resolved, and this time there's a real chance to close it. The one caution is relitigating old grievances just to win the earlier round, because the point of the return is repair, not a rematch. Say the thing underneath the argument. A household that resolves things late is doing far better than one that never resolves them.

headline: Old flames come back for review.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 5th house for a couple of months, sending romance and creative work back for revision. An ex or an old crush may reappear, and their return is a question rather than an answer: this pass exists so you can see the pattern clearly, whether that means closing the door properly or reopening it with better terms. Creative projects you dropped want a second look too, and the revision you do now tends to be the version that works, so edit the draft rather than starting a new one. Desire itself may run quieter, which is information, not a problem. The one caution is manufacturing drama just to feel motion, because chaos is not the same as passion. Revisit what came back, on purpose, and keep only what earns its return.

headline: Repair the routine, don't force it.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 6th house for a couple of months, sending your routines in for maintenance. The schedule that looked efficient may show its cracks now: the workout that keeps injuring you, the workflow with three unnecessary steps, the job duties that drifted far from what you agreed to. This is the window to repair rather than push, so fix the form before adding weight, renegotiate the workload before resenting it, and book the checkup you keep moving. Backlogs clear well under this influence; launches don't, so finish the open tickets before starting new ones. The one caution is blaming your body or your coworkers for a system problem, because frustration here loves the nearest target. Redesign the day so it stops requiring heroics. A routine rebuilt slowly is the one that holds.

headline: Same fight, better ending this time.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 7th house for a couple of months, bringing your closest relationships back to the negotiating table. The argument you two keep having, the one with the same script every time, comes around again, and this pass is different: the point now is to find what it's actually about, which is rarely the dishes. Renegotiate the standing agreements, who does what, who decides what, what was promised back when circumstances were different. An ex or an estranged friend may resurface, and you're allowed to decide what their return means before responding to it. Just don't start a brand-new war during the review of an old one, because grievances stack badly. One conflict, taken seriously and finished properly, can buy years of peace. That's what these two months are for.

headline: Reopen the file, then close it.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 8th house for a couple of months, reopening the files on what you share: joint accounts, debts, old financial entanglements. Paperwork from the past tends to resurface now, the loan terms worth rereading, the insurance claim that stalled, the money question from a former partnership that never got its final answer. Handle it, because this territory rewards a second pass: refinancing, consolidating, and untangling go better than new joint ventures, so review the terms rather than signing fresh ones. Intimacy has its review too, and old resentments about power or trust may surface asking to be discussed rather than deployed. The one caution is turning the review into a prosecution, because the goal here is release, not blame. Close the old accounts and the old arguments, and notice how much lighter shared life gets.

headline: Revise the map before you travel.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 9th house for a couple of months, sending your big plans back through review. Travel gets rearranged more than usual now, so build slack into the itinerary and reconfirm the bookings, and if a trip gets moved, treat the delay as scheduling rather than a sign. The degree you abandoned, the certification you never finished, the language you got halfway into: this is the window where going back to them works, because returning students do better under this influence than new enrollees. Your convictions get a second reading too, and you may notice you've been defending an opinion you inherited rather than chose. You're being asked to reexamine the belief, not to abandon believing. Rework the plan before the next departure. A belief you've reexamined travels better than one you defend.

headline: Stalled is not stopped.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 10th house for a couple of months, putting your career push on review. Momentum at work may slow, and the promotion or launch you were driving toward can stall through no fault of yours, so read the pause as scheduling: this is the window to sharpen the pitch, update the portfolio, and rebuild the plan you'll execute when traffic moves again. Old professional threads return usefully now, the former boss, the dormant application, the project that got shelved, and reheated opportunities are worth taking seriously. The one caution is quitting or clashing dramatically just to feel decisive, because exits made during a stall are the ones people regret and remember. Refine in private, deliver on time, keep a record of your wins. When Mars turns direct, you launch prepared.

headline: Old friends return; choose which ones.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 11th house for a couple of months, sending your social world back through review. Friction inside a group, the team, the committee, the group chat, tends to resurface now, usually over an old decision nobody fully accepted, and this pass exists so it can finally get discussed rather than managed. Old friends have a way of returning too, and some of those returns are the real gift of these months. Take a second look at your commitments while you're here: the cause you joined with your whole heart and now attend out of guilt deserves an honest decision. You don't owe anyone your permanent membership. Just don't torch the group over a fixable process problem. Repair the alliances worth keeping, release the rest, and your circle comes out truer.

headline: The quiet months do real work.
body: Mars is retrograde in your 12th house for a couple of months, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Energy may run at its lowest setting now, and that's the design, because the work of these months happens lying down, in therapy chairs, in notebooks, in the honest hour before sleep. Old angers you never voiced tend to resurface, some from years back, and feeling them through is the second pass they've been waiting for. Finish the endings you left open: the goodbye never said, the chapter closed in name only. Just don't mistake the low output for laziness and punish yourself into overdrive, because exhaustion here is a signal, not a character flaw. Rest deliberately, conclude gently. You'll cross back into the world with nothing dragging behind you.

headline: Walk in like you belong
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles you: your body, your presence, the first impression you make before you speak. Confidence grows on its own while he's here, and you can feel it working: you speak up sooner, people say yes more often, and doors that used to need pushing swing open at a touch. Use the year. Introduce yourself to the people you've admired from a distance, start the venture with your name on it, take up more space than you usually allow yourself. The one caution is promising more than one person can deliver, because everything feels possible right now and the calendar fills faster than the energy does. Say yes generously, keep a little margin, and let people see you at full size.

headline: Your worth is due for a raise
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your possessions, your sense of what you're worth. This transit has an old reputation for making money, and it tends to show up plainly: the raise finally comes through, the offer is higher than expected, the side project starts paying for itself. So negotiate like the year is on your side, because it is. Ask for the bigger number and price your work at what it actually costs you to do. The only thing to watch is that spending grows exactly as fast as income under this influence, and the upgrade habit can quietly eat the raise. Put some of the new money where it can keep growing, and let the rest buy a life you actually want.

headline: The year your words travel
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the ideas you carry around all day. Your voice travels further while he's here: the pitch gets a reply, the class has a seat left, and the neighborhood keeps handing you conversations worth having. This is the year to start the newsletter, take the course, or finally write the book you keep describing to friends at dinner. Say your ideas out loud, because people are unusually receptive right now. The one caution is signing up for more than one person can finish, since every subject looks fascinating under this influence and every project sounds like a weekend.
