Pick the two that matter most and go deep. A year of focused curiosity beats a decade of open tabs.

headline: Put down roots while luck helps
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. This is the classic year for upgrading the foundation: moving somewhere with more light, fixing the place you have, or finally resolving the family matter that has dragged on for years. Support from relatives comes easier now, and the household itself tends to grow, whether that's a baby, a partner moving in, or a kitchen that can finally hold everyone. If you've been thinking about putting down roots, start looking. The one caution is buying more house than your life needs, because everything looks affordable when you're optimistic. Size the dream to the people actually living in it. A home that fits makes the whole decade easier.

headline: A year built for enjoying yourself
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, kids, the things you do because you want to. Joy runs bigger while he's here. Dates go well, the hobby starts producing work you're proud of, and if you have children they seem determined to hand you stories worth retelling. This is the year to be seen as you actually are: post the work, plan the trip that's pure pleasure, say yes to the person who makes you laugh. If a relationship deepens now, it's because you're not pretending. The only thing to watch is excess, since pleasure this available invites bingeing on it. Leave some appetite for next month. Fun works best when there's another round coming.

headline: The daily grind turns generous
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: your routines, your work, your health. The ordinary parts of life improve while he's here. Conditions at work get better, or the work itself starts feeling worth doing, and habits begun now tend to stick because they start from optimism rather than punishment. Use that: book the checkup, build the morning you'd actually keep, take the role that gives you more to do and more to show for it. Helping other people goes well this year too, and it comes back in odd, useful ways. Just don't say yes to every task that needs a volunteer, because this transit expands workloads and waistlines with equal enthusiasm. Grow the parts of the routine you love, and trim the rest.

headline: Commit while the terms are kind
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. This is one of the best years to form or repair a one-to-one relationship. Commitments made now tend to age well, business partnerships open real doors, and helpful people have a habit of appearing exactly when you need them. If the conversation about moving in, making it official, or going into business together has been circling, land it this year. Even disagreements go better, because both of you are more generous than usual. The one caution is signing on enthusiasm alone, since contracts and people both look their best under this influence. Read every page, then commit like you mean it.

headline: Shared resources open in your favor
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, debts, beds, secrets. Other people's resources open to you while he's here. The loan gets approved, the backer appears, a partner's income rises, and shared finances that used to cause arguments start running smoothly. So have the money conversations now: consolidate the debt, redo the terms, ask for the investment. Depth is favored too, and therapy, intimacy, and the conversations you've been avoiding all go further than they usually can. If something big changes this year, it tends to change in your favor. The one caution is borrowing against optimism, because approved is not the same as affordable. Take only what the plan can carry, and the year stays yours.

headline: Go farther than feels sensible
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything outside your zip code. This is his favorite house, and it shows. The trip you keep researching becomes bookable, the degree or certification stops feeling out of reach, and ideas that used to sit flat suddenly reorganize how you see your life. Go: enroll, buy the ticket, read the book that intimidates you, talk to people who grew up nowhere near you. Your view of the world widens if you let it, and this year it widens fast. The only way to waste these months is deciding you already know everything, because certainty is the one thing Jupiter cannot expand. Stay a student and the year keeps paying.

headline: Climb while the climbing is easy
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. Doors open at the top while he's here. Promotions, bigger titles, and visible assignments come easier, and the people deciding are inclined to say yes to you. So ask for what you've been building toward: the role, the raise, the meeting with the person above your boss. Take the project everyone will see, because visibility compounds this year. The one caution is taking every opportunity just because it's offered, since a career can grow past the life it was supposed to fund. Choose the wins that match your values, and stay easy to work with on the way up. People remember both.

headline: Your circle wants to grow
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, group chats, communities, the causes you show up for. Your circle grows almost on its own while he's here. New friends worth keeping arrive through old ones, the group project finds momentum, and what you give to your people has a way of coming back larger. So show up: organize the dinner, join the club you've been eyeing, volunteer for the cause that keeps crossing your feed. Long-term goals move faster with company this year, so say your ambitions out loud where friends can hear them. The one caution is collecting acquaintances until no one really knows you, because a wide circle is not the same as a close one. Pick a few and give them your actual time.

headline: The quiet year that changes everything
body: Jupiter is spending about a year in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This is the quiet kind of good year. Not much shows on the outside, but underneath, compassion grows, old guilt loosens, and you get braver about looking at yourself directly. A teacher, a book, or a practice tends to find you at exactly the right moment now, so when something keeps recommending itself, follow it. Protect your alone time too, because that's where this year does its work: the journal, the therapy, the long walks without your phone. Just don't disappear entirely, since retreat can slide into hiding. Growth nobody sees counts anyway. Next year it will show; this year, let it root.

headline: Tailor the growth to fit you
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 1st house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles you: your body, your presence, how you introduce yourself to the world. Growth doesn't stop during a retrograde; it turns inward for a second pass. The confidence you've been building gets reviewed now, and you may notice which parts of the new you fit and which were borrowed for the occasion. Use these months to refine rather than launch: revise the plan, rework the introduction, let the bigger self you've been trying on get tailored to your actual shape. Someone who knew an earlier version of you may reappear and show you how far you've come. The only thing to watch is treating the pause like a failure. It's a fitting, not a setback, and what fits gets to stay.

headline: Review the money, keep the worth
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 2nd house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: income, possessions, self-worth. The money expansion isn't over; it's under review. These months favor the second look: renegotiate the rate you set back when you valued yourself less, cancel the subscriptions that outlived their point, chase the invoice that never got paid. An old income source or a former client may come back around, and this time you get to name better terms. It's a refining window, so hold off on the big new purchase or the brand-new venture and improve the ones already running. The one caution is doubting your worth just because the growth got quiet, since a pause in the harvest is not a failure of the field. Tend what's planted. It's growing.

headline: Second drafts are the good ones
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 3rd house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles your words: messages, ideas, siblings, the daily rounds. Big ideas come back for editing now. The writing project you shelved, the course you abandoned two modules in, the conversation with a sibling that ended in the wrong place: each of them returns asking for a second pass, and the second pass is where they get good. Rewrite before you publish, reread before you reply, and let the pitch sit overnight before it goes out. You may also hear from people you used to talk to every day, and picking the thread back up can be worth it. Just don't mistake revision for going backwards, because a sentence rewritten five times isn't late. It's finished properly.

headline: Home plans improve with waiting
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 4th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. Plans for the foundation slow down so they can improve. The move gets rescheduled, the renovation gets redrawn, and the family conversation you thought was over reopens with more honesty in it the second time. Let that happen, because home and family are exactly the places where the first draft is rarely the best one. These months are good for repairs of every kind: fix what's broken in the house, revisit what went unsaid at the holidays, call the relative who's been waiting for you to go first. The one caution is forcing a decision about where you live before the picture clears. The right place will be right in a few months too.

headline: Old flames, old art, second looks
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 5th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the things you do for their own sake. This is the classic window for the past to circle back. An old flame may reappear, or an old creative project may start calling from the drawer, and both deserve a real second look rather than an automatic yes or no. Ask what has actually changed since last time, then decide. Creatively, these months favor revision over debut: rework the manuscript, re-edit the photos, practice the set before you book the show. Joy itself may go quieter and more private for a while, and that's allowed. Just don't force the fun onto a schedule. Pleasure that gets a second pass comes back with better taste.

headline: Keep the habit, shrink it first
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 6th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health. The improvements you've been making to ordinary life come up for review. The routine that got ambitious in January gets audited by what you actually do on a Tuesday, and whatever survives that audit is the part worth keeping. Rebuild the habit smaller and it will hold. At work, revisit the systems rather than adding new ones: the process that almost works, the workload that quietly doubled, the role that drifted from its description. It's also the right window for the follow-up appointment you've been putting off. The one caution is treating the trimming like defeat, because a routine cut in half and kept is worth ten abandoned ideals.

headline: Reread the fine print together
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 7th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles the other person: partners, best friends, the one across the table. Relationships don't shrink in these months; they get reviewed. Agreements made in an optimistic hour come back for an honest rereading, and who does what, who pays for what, and what was actually promised all deserve a second conversation. Have it, because terms renegotiated now tend to hold. A former partner or an old friend may also resurface, and the point isn't always reunion; sometimes it's just clarity about why things went the way they did. Take the clarity either way. The one caution is renegotiating everything at once, since a partnership under constant review stops being restful. Fix the one term that matters most first.

headline: Refinance, review, then recommit
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 8th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, debts, intimacy, secrets. Shared arrangements come up for a second pass now, and it's a productive one. Refinance the loan, review the terms you signed in a hurry, look at what the joint account actually pays for, ask whose name is on what and why. Old financial threads can resurface too: a debt someone forgot, a payout that finally clears, paperwork from a chapter you thought was closed. Handle them and they stay handled. The same review works in closeness, and saying out loud what you've each been carrying counts as maintenance too. Just don't sign anything major mid-review if it can wait. The refined deal is the better deal.

headline: Question the beliefs, keep the best
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 9th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, the meaning you steer by. The expansion turns inward now, and questions you thought you'd answered ask to be answered again: whether the degree is for you or for your parents, whether the philosophy you quote actually holds up in your ordinary week. Reexamine them, because beliefs that survive a retrograde are the ones worth building on. Travel plans may reroute or return you somewhere you've already been, and the second visit tends to teach more than the first. It's also the season to finish the course you started and left. The one caution is calling the questioning a crisis. Doubt is how a belief proves it can hold weight, and yours are getting stronger.

headline: The detour is part of the climb
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 10th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. The climb doesn't reverse in these months; it pauses to check the map. The promotion may take longer to finalize, the launch may push back a quarter, and the plan you made two years ago deserves rereading against who you've become since. Do the rereading, because an ambition that no longer fits will cost you a decade if you keep serving it. Old professional doors can reopen too: a former employer, a shelved project, a contact from an earlier chapter with better timing now. The one caution is treating the delay like a demotion. What arrives after review arrives sturdier, and sturdier is what a reputation is made of.

headline: Old friends are circling back
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 11th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, communities, causes. Your social world goes into review mode, and it's overdue. Old friends have a way of coming back around now, and the reunion that actually happens is one of this transit's best gifts. Meanwhile the newer circle gets sorted: which groups give you energy back, which ones only take, which cause has your heart and which just has your calendar. Trim accordingly; nobody worth keeping will be lost. It's also a good window to revise the long-term goal you set with friends' applause in your ears, and to make sure it's yours. Just don't announce the big collective plan yet. Refine it while the retrograde lasts, then launch it to a circle that's actually yours.

headline: Go inward, come back wiser
body: Jupiter is retrograde in your 12th house for a few months, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This retrograde barely looks like anything from the outside, which is exactly the point. The year's growth comes inside to be understood: old chapters ask for rereading, dreams get louder, and you finally have the patience to look at what you've been too busy to feel. Give the process real time alone, because insight under this transit arrives in the quiet hours, not the scheduled ones. Forgiveness gets easier now too, including for yourself, and something you've been dragging around for years can be set down for good. The one caution is isolating past the point of usefulness. Retreat is for returning. Take these months inward, then bring back what you find.

headline: You are under construction, on purpose.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles who you are: your body, your name, the way you walk into a place. The volume turns down while he's here. You may have zero patience for holding the posture and more appetite for the slow work of becoming someone, and from the outside that can look like withdrawal. It isn't. It's construction. Use the window to build the discipline you've been meaning to build: the training, the routine, the habit that makes you proud by Friday. Just don't read the tiredness as failure, because Saturn slows you down so you stop spending effort on the wrong things. The person who comes out of these years is sturdier than the one going in, and you'll know how you got that way.

headline: Money is teaching, not punishing you.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your bills, your sense of what you're worth. Money asks to be taken seriously while he's here. Raises come slower, expenses arrive on schedule, and the number in your account starts telling the truth about your habits. Use the window: make the budget you've been avoiding, pay down the debt, learn what things actually cost. You'll also find out your worth was never the number, because Saturn tests self-esteem here too. The one caution is scarcity thinking, the reflex that says there will never be enough, because decisions made from panic cost more than any shortfall. Manage what you have with care and it grows the slow way, which is the way that lasts.

headline: Your words are gaining weight.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: what you say, what you sign, the siblings and neighbors you say it to. Speech gets heavier while he's here. You'll think twice before answering, conversations with relatives may turn serious, and small talk can feel like work. That's not a loss; it's editing. Use the window to learn something properly: the course that takes two years, the skill you can't cram, because what you study under Saturn stays learned. Depth beats speed now. The one caution is going quiet because talking takes effort, since the people close to you will fill your silence with their own guesses. Say less if you need to, but say it clearly, and your word starts carrying real authority.

headline: Repair the roots and they hold.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home and family: the house, the parents, everything you come from. The private side of life gets heavy while he's here. Repairs come due, parents may need more from you, and old family patterns show up asking to be dealt with, not passed down again. Handle the structural problems now, the leak and the lease and the conversation your family has been avoiding for a decade, because what you fix in these years holds for decades. The one caution is treating home as nothing but obligation, since a foundation built with resentment cracks. Build the household you'd actually want to come back to. Saturn isn't taking your comfort away; he's asking you to pour it in concrete.

headline: Take what you love seriously.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the kids in your life. The light things get serious while he's here. Dating feels less like a game and more like an interview, creative work stops running on inspiration alone, and children may need more from you than they give back. Here's the trade: what you make with discipline in these years can be the best work you've ever done, and a romance that survives Saturn tends to be the real thing. So finish the album, take the class, show up for the kid. The one caution is deciding that joy is over, because heaviness here is a test of what you love, not a removal of it. Play like it matters, because it does.

headline: Small habits, built to last.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: your routines, your workload, your health. The small tasks stop being optional while he's here. The body starts keeping records of how it's been treated, work arrives with your name on it, and the shape of an ordinary day suddenly matters. Take that as instruction: book the checkup, fix the sleep, build the routine that runs even on your bad weeks, because habits made under Saturn tend to hold for decades. The one caution is turning discipline into punishment, since Saturn rewards consistency, not suffering, and a routine you resent won't survive the first hard month. You don't owe anyone your exhaustion. Keep the days simple and repeatable, and your health becomes the thing you can count on.

headline: Every promise gets weighed now.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, anyone you've made promises to. Relationships get weighed while he's here. Solid ones deepen, usually through the unglamorous work of clearer agreements, and shaky ones may end, though if they do, the ending was a long time coming. Use the window to make things explicit: who does what, what was promised, what commitment means to each of you. If you're single, you may meet someone serious, possibly older, and slower is a feature, not a flaw. The one caution is keeping score, because Saturn asks for fairness, and fairness used as a weapon becomes a wall. Keep your promises carefully and ask the same in return; what survives these years lasts for good.

headline: Carry it yourself for a while.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: joint money, debts, intimacy, the private things. Outside support may thin out while he's here. The loan comes slower, a partner may earn less, backing you counted on can step back, and the lesson inside all of it is self-sufficiency. Arrange your life to run on what you bring in yourself, pay down what you owe, and put shared accounts in order. Intimacy gets serious too: fewer games, more truth about what closeness actually costs. Heavier thoughts about time and mortality can visit too; let them make you serious, not afraid. The one caution is sealing yourself off entirely, because self-reliance is a skill, not a personality. What you learn to carry now, you'll never fear carrying again.

headline: Keep the beliefs that hold up.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger picture: travel, study, belief, everything past your zip code. Your worldview gets a stress test while he's here. Ideas that only sound good start failing in daily use, teachers get questioned, and travel leans practical, more work trip than pilgrimage. That's the point: Saturn wants a philosophy that carries weight, not one that decorates. Use the window for serious study, the degree, the certification, the long book you've been circling, because what you learn becomes structural. The one caution is trading a big open faith for a small bitter certainty, since disillusionment loves to dress up as wisdom. Test what you believe and keep what passes. A worldview should be a guideline you trust, not a cage you defend.

headline: The harvest arrives, ready or not.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. This is the harvest. What you've built over the last decade comes due now, the promotion, the leadership, the title, or the bill, if corners were cut. Responsibility stacks up because people trust you with it, and the trust is earned, so take the bigger job and do it clean. The one caution is letting the climb eat everything else, because Saturn will hand you exactly as much duty as you accept, and some of your hours belong to a life outside work. Keep some evenings for the people who knew you before the title. Respect earned slowly is the kind nobody can take back.

headline: Fewer people, deeper roots.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, the causes and long-range plans you show up for. Friendship gets serious while he's here. Some connections prove themselves through the boring loyalty of actually showing up, others quietly stop fitting, and a few old ambitions turn out to belong to a person you no longer are. Keep the goals you'd want even if nobody was watching, and keep the two or three friends who tell you the truth. It's also a good stretch for real commitment to a cause: the organizing work, the unglamorous part. The one caution is deciding a smaller circle means a failed one, because Saturn trims for strength, not punishment, and what remains is a circle you can actually build on.

headline: Finish everything before the new cycle.
body: Saturn is spending the next couple of years in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Things wrap up while he's here. Old projects push toward their finish, some people drift off, and habits that ran your life from behind the scenes finally step into the light. It can feel like loss when it's actually clearing. Use these years for finishing: close the chapter properly, do the therapy, sit with yourself long enough to hear what you actually think. The one caution is mistaking retreat for defeat, because this stretch comes right before Saturn begins a whole new cycle in your 1st house, and you'll want to arrive rested. Let the endings be endings; what comes next is being built in the quiet, and it's yours.

headline: The blueprint comes back for review.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 1st house for a few months, which sends the work you've been doing on yourself back for review. The discipline you built, the boundaries you drew, the person you've been becoming: some of it fits and some of it needs adjusting, and this stretch shows you which is which. Maybe the routine was stricter than a person can actually live with, or a commitment you made to yourself was made for someone else's approval. Revise it. A second pass isn't backsliding; it's how anything worth keeping gets built. The move is refine, not launch: hold off on reinventing yourself and tune the version already in progress. Just don't read the review as failure, because Saturn only double-checks the things he intends to keep. When he moves forward again, so will you, on truer footing.

headline: Check the numbers one more time.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 2nd house for a few months, and money matters you thought were handled come back for a second look. A payment plan wants renegotiating, an old debt resurfaces, the budget you wrote in January stops matching the life you're actually living. Go through it line by line: what you earn, what you owe, what you keep buying out of habit. Money owed to you from the past can also come back now, so send the reminder. None of this is a setback; it's an audit you're running on yourself, and numbers only improve when somebody actually looks at them. The one caution is scarcity panic, because a review reveals things, it doesn't take anything from you. Adjust the plan to match reality, and it finally starts working when Saturn moves forward again.

headline: Say it again, better this time.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 3rd house for a few months, and conversations you thought were finished come back for another round. The misunderstanding with a sibling, the email chain that ended badly, the paperwork you filed and forgot: unfinished business in your everyday world wants a second pass. What you couldn't say clearly the first time, you can say clearly now, because a few months of distance turned the mess into information. It's also the right window to return to a course or a book you abandoned; what you dropped wasn't wasted, it was paused. The move is revise, not broadcast, so hold the announcement until the words are ready. The one caution is rehearsing old arguments to win them, because the point of a second pass is repair. Say the truer sentence and let the old draft go.

headline: The family business isn't finished yet.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 4th house for a few months, and the home front asks for a second pass. The repair that was patched rather than fixed, the family conversation that got interrupted, the arrangement about who takes care of what: unfinished business under your own roof comes back around now. Relatives from the past may resurface too, and old family patterns you thought you'd outgrown can show up wearing new clothes. Don't be discouraged; you're not back at the start, you're back at the one spot that got skipped. Redo the repair properly, reopen the conversation gently, and renegotiate the household duties out loud. The one caution is blaming yourself for the return trip, because foundations get inspected precisely because they're meant to carry weight. Handle it once, correctly, and it won't come back a third time.

headline: Old joys ask for a rewrite.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 5th house for a few months, and the things you make and love come back asking for revision. The creative project you shelved wants another draft, and this time you have the skill it was waiting for. An old romance may resurface too, and Saturn's question about it is practical: did it end for reasons that have actually changed? If yes, the second conversation can be worth having; if not, the return is just a rerun. With kids, an old topic may need reopening with more patience this time. The move is refine, not relaunch, so finish the existing project before starting something shiny. The one caution is grading your old work harshly, because you made it with the tools you had then. Revise it with respect and it comes out better than before.

headline: Adjust the routine, don't abandon it.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 6th house for a few months, and the routine gets called in for maintenance. The schedule that worked on paper, the health plan you started strong and quietly dropped, the workload you agreed to before you knew its real size: all of it comes back for adjustment, which is not the same as failure. Rebook the checkup you cancelled, restart the habit at half the original intensity, and renegotiate the parts of your job that were never in the description. Old health matters may want a follow-up now, so give them one; a second look is care, not alarm. The one caution is scrapping the whole routine because one part broke, since perfectionism quits faster than laziness does. Fix the one hinge that squeaks, and the rest of the machine works better than you think.

headline: Renegotiate before you walk away.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 7th house for a few months, and your closest relationships come up for renegotiation. Agreements that seemed clear turn out to have two versions, one in each person's head, and this is the window to compare notes rather than keep guessing. A partner may need to revisit something you considered resolved; let them, because a topic revisited together is closer to finished than a topic dropped. Someone from the past can also reappear, an ex or an old business partner, and the question worth asking is what the return is for: repair, closure, or repetition. The first two deserve your time. The one caution is reading the rework as proof the relationship is failing, because the couples who renegotiate are the ones who last. Slow conversations now save you years later.

headline: The shared accounts want another look.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 8th house for a few months, and shared arrangements come back for review. The loan terms, the joint account, the split that made sense when it was drawn up: numbers involving other people want a fresh look now, and so do the agreements nobody wrote down. Old debts can resurface in both directions, money you owe and money owed to you, and this is the stretch to resolve them for good. Intimacy gets its own second pass: a conversation about trust that went badly once can go better now, if you both return to it on purpose. The one caution is using the review to reopen blame, because the goal is cleaner terms, not a retrial. Sort out what's shared, say what's owed, and what you've been carrying gets lighter.

headline: Retest what you decided to believe.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 9th house for a few months, and your big conclusions come back for retesting. The belief you adopted, the plan you committed to, the opinion you've been defending on autopilot: each one gets asked to show its work again. That's useful, because a conviction that survives a second examination is one you can build on. Unfinished studies belong to this window too; the degree, the certification, the training you left may be worth walking back to, and a trip you put off can get planned properly. The move is deepen, not convert: no swapping one borrowed philosophy for another. The one caution is cynicism, the lazy cousin of discernment, because doubting everything is just as unexamined as believing everything. Keep what passes the retest, and what you're left with is faith you can stand on.

headline: The plan deserves a second draft.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 10th house for a few months, and the career plan goes back to the drawing board. A promotion or project may stall, a decision above your head gets delayed, and the ambition you've been executing without question quietly asks whether it's the right one. Use the pause on purpose: revise the plan, redo the portfolio, finish the credential that's been ninety percent done for a year. People from your professional past can resurface now, an old boss, an old client, and those returns often carry real work inside them. The one caution is treating the delay as the world's opinion of you, because a stalled timeline measures traffic, not talent. What you refine during the pause is exactly what gets rewarded when things move again, and they do move again.

headline: Old friends return with unfinished business.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 11th house for a few months, and your circle gets a second look. A friendship that cooled may come back around, an old friend can reappear with something unresolved between you, and a group you left may ask you to return. Each return deserves the same question: does this connection fit the person you are now, or the person you were when it started? Long-range goals get the review too; some were inherited from an older version of you, and you're allowed to retire them without a ceremony. The move is renegotiate, not recruit, so deepen the connections you already have before collecting new ones. The one caution is rejoining out of guilt, because obligation makes a poor foundation for friendship. Keep what fits on purpose, and your circle comes out smaller, truer, and yours.

headline: Give the past its proper ending.
body: Saturn is retrograde in your 12th house for a few months, and the past asks for one more look. Old endings that were rushed, the job you left without a goodbye, the grief you scheduled for later and never got back to: what wasn't finished properly comes back so it can be. This is quiet work and it wants quiet conditions, so protect your solitude, keep the calendar light, and let sleep and journaling do the lifting. Dreams and memories may get loud; treat them as messages from parts of you that never got an answer. The one caution is mistaking this review for going backward, because you're not returning to the past, you're releasing it correctly this time. Finish the unfinished gently; what you close now stays closed, and you walk into the next cycle lighter.

headline: The old role stopped fitting first
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles you: your body, your name, the way people think they know you. The pull this whole time is toward freedom, and it starts as restlessness: the title feels like a costume, the plan feels like a script, and you keep surprising people who thought they had you figured out. Good. Most of what's changing was overdue, and the restlessness is information about exactly where change is overdue. Use these years to change what has actually gone stale: the look, the label, the role you took because it was expected. Just don't tear down the parts that work for the feeling of tearing something down, because this transit only turns rocky when you refuse to move at all. Move first and it feels like liberation.

headline: Flexible beats rich for a while
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your things, your sense of what you're worth. Money changes shape here, sometimes overnight: windfalls, dry spells, a way of earning you'd never have predicted for yourself. The strongest position is a flexible one, which means savings you can actually reach, skills that transfer, and no bet that requires everything staying exactly as it is. Underneath the numbers, something bigger is moving too, because by the end of this what you own will matter less to you and what you can do will matter more. The one caution is clinging to an income purely because it's familiar, since the change tends to come anyway. Choosing it early keeps it on your terms.

headline: Let the route change on you
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your daily world: words, errands, siblings, the streets you know by heart. The reliable little loop turns unpredictable while he's here. Plans reroute themselves, new people appear on old corners, and subjects you never cared about grab you out of nowhere and change how you think. Your voice changes with it: the honest sentence starts arriving before the polite one, and people notice you've stopped softening your opinions. Let them notice. Use these years to follow the strange interest, take the different route, write the thing that doesn't sound like anyone else. Just don't defend the old routine on principle, because the interruptions are where the interesting ideas keep coming from.

headline: Home is due for a redesign
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. These years tend to move the furniture in the largest sense: a move you didn't see coming, a household that changes shape, a family truth that surfaces after a long quiet. When the old setup goes, it can feel like the floor going with it. It isn't. It's the beginning of a freer version of home, one you get to design on purpose this time. Use the window to build around who you are now rather than who you were raised to be, and to say the honest thing at the family table at last. Just don't confuse the end of an arrangement with the end of belonging. Home is coming with you.

headline: The spark won't sign a contract
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the kids in your life. Everything here runs electric for a while. Exciting people arrive fast, feelings arrive faster, and the creative ideas that show up now won't look like anyone else's, so make them. If you have kids, expect them to insist on being exactly who they are, which is the transit working. Take the strange class, start the unusual project, say yes to the person you'd normally never pick. The one caution is asking these connections for guarantees, because what begins under Uranus is better at intensity than permanence, and demanding a promise from a spark just puts it out. Enjoy it for what it is and it gives you plenty.

headline: Redesign the day before it redesigns you
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health. The clearest signal of this transit is that a job running on nothing but "have to" becomes very hard to keep doing. That's not failure, that's the point. The fix is more freedom, and it comes in versions: a different role, new skills, more say over how your own day is built. Make the change deliberately and early, because tension you sit on under this transit has a habit of coming out through the body: the back, the stomach, the sleep. Treat those as messages rather than malfunctions, and answer them while they're small. Redesign the day while it's a choice, and the freedom pays for itself.

headline: The overdue conversation is about freedom
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. What this transit asks of a partnership is honesty about freedom: who has it, who gave it up, who quietly resents the trade. That conversation tends to arrive on its own schedule, so have it early and on yours. A solid relationship can absolutely come through these years looser, more honest, and better, and one that was already hollow may end abruptly, which is the same force doing you a different favor. Use the window to update the agreement: the roles, the deal about time apart, what you're each allowed to want. Just don't wait for the crisis to renegotiate, because while it remains a conversation, everything is possible.

headline: Nothing shared stays fixed for long
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: joint money, sex, secrets, other people's resources. The shared side of life gets unpredictable here. A partner's income can change without warning, a joint arrangement may need restructuring midstream, and the big questions tend to show up earlier than anyone planned. The move for these years is to travel light: keep obligations flexible, think twice about long-range debt, and avoid any plan that only works if someone else's money never changes. Intimacy shifts too, because honesty about what you actually want gets harder to suppress, and that's a gift even when it's awkward at first. Just don't mistake flexibility for distrust. You can keep things light on paper and deep everywhere else.

headline: Every correction opens something bigger
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything past the edge of the familiar. Being wrong gets useful here. Events keep contradicting what you were sure of, and each correction opens more than it closes: a place you swore you'd never go, a subject you dismissed, a person whose worldview rearranges yours over one dinner. Say yes to that. Book the trip that scares you a little, start the course that doesn't match your resume, let the belief you inherited take some questions. The only way to lose these years is rigidity, because defending a certainty this transit has already outgrown just makes the lesson louder. Stay curious and this becomes one of the most expansive stretches you get.

headline: Choose the change before it chooses you
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. Restlessness about your profession builds through this transit until something moves: the role, the field, or you. You get to pick which, but only if you pick early, because waiting for the breaking point makes the change messy and choosing it first makes it yours. Use the window to test the pivot while the current job is intact: the training, the side project, the conversations with people already doing the work you keep thinking about. Watch the friction with authority, and win those fights with timing rather than defiance. The work you eventually land in fits the person you're becoming, not the resume you had.

headline: Follow the interesting people
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, the causes you show up for. The circle is due for turnover, and this is one of the friendlier versions of this transit, so let it turn. New people arrive who challenge how you think, and some old ones quietly stop fitting the person you've become, which is nobody's fault and doesn't need a trial. You'll also notice you've stopped accepting as little as you used to, socially and otherwise, and your goals update to match. Follow the interesting people, join the odd group, sign up for the cause that actually moves you. Just don't keep a friendship alive out of habit alone, because loyalty to habit isn't loyalty to the person.

headline: What was buried is getting up
body: Uranus is spending the next several years in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. Buried material stops staying buried here. Habits you didn't know were running you show themselves mid-act, old secrets surface on their own schedule, and consequences of decisions long shelved come looking for a signature. It can feel destabilizing, but the timing is a gift, because whatever comes up now can finally be dealt with rather than managed. Therapy, journaling, and any practice that reaches under the surface do unusually good work during this stretch, so start one. The one caution is pushing what surfaces back down, since it only comes back louder. Let it up, look at it, and you get to put it down for good.

headline: The rebellion goes inward for review
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 1st house for several months, the part of your chart that handles you: your body, your name, how you present yourself. The reinvention doesn't stop during this stretch, it turns inward. Use the second pass to sort which of your recent changes were actually yours and which were reactions: the new look you chose versus the one you grabbed to prove a point, the boundary you meant versus the one you drew mid-argument. An older version of you may resurface for comparison, through old friends, old photos, old reflexes, and that's useful information, not backsliding. Keep what fits, adjust what doesn't, and hold off on the next dramatic overhaul until the review is done. A second pass isn't a setback. It's how a reinvention becomes permanent.

headline: Refine the money experiment first
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 2nd house for several months, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: income, possessions, your sense of your own worth. The financial experiments of the past stretch come up for review now: the side income, the new way of earning, the purchases that were supposed to change your life. Some passed the test and some didn't, and you're allowed to say which is which. Use the window to renegotiate rather than launch: rework the rate, refinance the loan, cancel the subscription you've been ignoring, and revisit the income idea you dropped too early, because it may be viable now. Just don't make the dramatic financial leap while the review is running, since the numbers you'd base it on are mid-revision. Refine first. The bolder move goes better after.

headline: Unfinished sentences want finishing
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 3rd house for several months, the part of your chart that handles your daily world: words, errands, siblings, the neighborhood. Conversations from the past circle back during this stretch: the sibling topic that never got finished, the argument you won but didn't resolve, the idea you dropped right before it got good. Pick those back up, because the second pass is what this window is for. Your opinions are mid-revision too, and the take you were certain of a few months ago may need editing, so let it be edited. Revisit the abandoned draft, reread before you reply, take the old route once and see what you notice now. Just don't announce the big conclusion yet. The thinking you refine in these months is the thinking you'll act on later.

headline: Repair first, relocate after
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 4th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. The big domestic change slows down here so you can get it right: the move gets delayed, the renovation gets rescoped, the plan to leave or to stay comes up for one more honest look. Take the look. Family business from the past tends to reopen during this stretch too, and a conversation that went badly the first time can go better on the second try, because everyone has had months to think. Use the window for repair rather than demolition: fix the terms, revisit the arrangement, say what you meant more carefully this time. A delayed move isn't a denied one. It's the chance to choose it twice.

headline: Not every spark needs reigniting
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 5th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the kids in your life. The past gets flirtatious during this stretch. Someone electric you never finished with may reappear, and the shelved creative project starts making eyes at you from the drawer. Give both a second look, but a look is not a leap: some sparks come back to be revived and some come back so you can confirm what you learned, and you usually know which within one conversation. The project is the easier yes, so reopen the file, rework the old material, finish what you abandoned when it got hard. Just don't restart something purely for the jolt of restarting it. Revisiting is the point of these months. Repeating isn't.

headline: Tune the schedule, keep the freedom
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 6th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health. The escape plan comes up for review here. If you've been redesigning your work life, this is the stretch to check which changes actually hold: the schedule that looked liberating on paper but exhausts you in practice, the new system nobody follows, the freedom that turned out to be three extra jobs. Adjust rather than overhaul again. Your body files its reports during this window too, and the symptom you brushed off months ago may come back for proper attention, so give it the appointment this time. Just don't read the tinkering as failure, because routines are built by revision. The version you refine now is the one that finally lasts.

headline: Draft two of the new deal
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 7th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. The renegotiation comes back around here. Whatever you two recently reworked, the time, the roles, the freedom each of you gets, returns for refinement, usually because the new deal was drafted fast and lived in slowly. That's not the agreement failing, that's the agreement getting real. Someone from your past can also resurface during this stretch, an ex, an old business partner, a friend you fell out with, and the point of their return is clarity, not necessarily reunion. Use the window to say the part you left out last time. Renegotiated twice beats resented quietly, every single time.

headline: Loose ends in the shared accounts
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 8th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles what you share: joint money, sex, secrets, other people's resources. Old terms come back for a proper close here. The debt you split informally, the account nobody reconciled, the agreement you made when circumstances were different: this is the stretch to reopen them on purpose and close them cleanly. Renegotiate the arrangement that's been quietly unfair, chase the paperwork that never got its final signature, ask the question about the shared money you've been avoiding. Intimacy runs on the same rule right now, because the honest conversation you had halfway through deserves its second half. Just don't sign brand-new joint obligations mid-review; refine the existing ones first. What you close properly now stays closed.

headline: Question the answer you just adopted
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 9th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles the bigger world: travel, study, belief, everything past the edge of the familiar. The new worldview comes up for review here. If a recent conviction replaced an old one overnight, this stretch checks whether you traded one certainty for another rather than actually getting freer, and that check is worth passing. Revisit the course you abandoned, the trip that fell through, the book you quit a third of the way in, because second attempts in this territory tend to go further than first ones. A teacher or a place from your past may pull at you again, and it's worth following. Just don't enroll in the next big answer during the review. The point of these months is better questions.

headline: Make sure the leap has a direction
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 10th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. The career pivot pauses here so you can check its direction, because there's a difference between moving toward work you want and just moving away from work you're sick of, and only one of those survives contact with an ordinary Tuesday. Use the stretch to review the plan, the numbers, and the version of the goal you wrote before you knew better. A former boss, client, or colleague may resurface with something useful, and old work of yours can find a second life, so answer those messages. Just don't hand in the dramatic resignation mid-review. The exit goes better once the revision is finished.

headline: Old friends return with information
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 11th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, the causes you show up for. The circle gets a second look here. An old friend may resurface changed, or you resurface changed to them, and the reunion tells you quickly whether the friendship was paused or finished; both answers are useful. The groups you joined recently come up for review too, so notice which meetings you leave energized and which you leave relieved, because that's the entire test. Recommit to the cause that holds up, and let yourself resign from the one you joined for a version of you that's gone. Just don't recruit a whole new circle mid-review. Finish leaving before you start arriving. The people who fit will keep.

headline: One more pass, then peace
body: Uranus is retrograde in your 12th house for several months, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. What surfaced earlier comes back for one more pass, and that's the design, not a relapse. The old habit makes another appearance so you can watch it happen with new eyes, the secret you half-told asks to be finished, the ending you rushed wants its real goodbye. Give these months the quiet they're asking for: the journal, the therapy thread you dropped, the long walks without headphones. Insight arrives out of nowhere in this territory once you stop performing for anyone, including yourself. Just don't mistake the habit's return for proof that nothing changed, because recognizing it mid-act is the change. This pass is the one that takes.

headline: You're becoming someone you haven't met
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles who you are: your face, your name, the self you lead with. Identity goes soft while it's here. Old certainties stop holding, people describe you differently from one month to the next, and some days you barely recognize yourself in your own stories. The drift is the point: something wiser is forming underneath, and it can't form while you're gripping the old outline. Use these years for whatever feeds imagination, art, music, prayer, long walks with no destination, and keep the practical anchors close: work, sleep, friends who tell you the truth. The one caution is rescue, because saving people and being saved both get complicated when nobody sees anybody clearly. You're allowed to be a draft for a while.

headline: Believe the paperwork, not the pitch
body: Neptune is spending years in your 2nd house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles what's yours: your income, your things, your sense of what you're worth. Money gets blurry under this transit, not dramatically, just quietly: optimistic numbers, vague offers, deals that sound better out loud than they look on paper. So make paper the rule. Read contracts twice, confirm what was promised in writing, and skip anything that requires believing a stranger's enthusiasm, especially speculation, which is specifically a bad idea now. Something gentler is happening underneath the caution: what you own is mattering less to you, and what you value is drifting toward things no one can invoice. Let it drift. The one thing to watch is wishful math, because you'll want the numbers to work. Check whether they actually do.

headline: Your imagination is louder than the facts
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the daily back and forth. Everyday communication goes soft here. Plans get remembered three different ways, messages read two ways, and you'll swear someone said the thing they swear they never said. Put the details in writing and ask the obvious question even when it feels silly; nobody minds, and it saves whole arguments. The same blur has a gift inside it: your imagination and intuition are running unusually strong, and they'll do beautiful work in anything creative, poems, songs, the story you keep meaning to start. Just don't use them on contracts. Dream on the page, and be literal in the paperwork.

headline: Home can be loved without being perfect
body: Neptune is spending years in your 4th house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. A longing runs through this transit: you want home to be a sanctuary, softer and more meaningful than any actual household with dishes in the sink can manage. Improve the place, light the candles, make it beautiful, then forgive it for being real. Family matters can run confusing during these years, and a parent may need more care than before; small honest conversations will do more than the perfect holiday ever could. Old memories surface too, arriving kinder than the moments actually were. The one caution is chasing the picture, because a home is a place you live, not a photograph you finally get right. Water the plants and let it be imperfect.

headline: The halo is yours, not theirs
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, flirting, the things you do purely for joy. Romance wants to be transcendent now. You won't just like someone, you'll recognize them, and the feeling of destiny can arrive by the second date. The feelings are real; the halo is optional. Enjoy every candlelit minute and keep quietly checking what the person actually does, because under this transit you can fall for your own imagination wearing someone else's face. The consolation is enormous: this is the best creative imagination you'll ever have, so paint, write, film, make things. Skip the gambling, since feeling lucky is part of the transit rather than evidence. Let the dream feed your art, not your judgment of people.

headline: Boring health advice works best now
body: Neptune is spending years in your 6th house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health. Your body gets more sensitive during this transit, and so does your patience with meaningless tasks. Energy can dip for no visible reason, reactions to alcohol and medication run stronger than they used to, and miracle cures start looking strangely convincing. Choose boring on purpose: sleep, water, the proven routine, the doctor who orders the actual test. At work, the ladder stops motivating you and service starts to; the parts of your job that help a real person will feel worth doing. The one caution is drifting through your days on autopilot, because vagueness in this house shows up in the body first. Keep the routine simple and keep it kind.

headline: Devotion needs accurate eyesight
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. Close relationships run on guesswork during these years. You fill in their silences with your own script, they do the same with yours, and both of you can be devoted to a version of the other that neither of you actually is. The repair is unglamorous: say the resentment while it's small, ask what they meant rather than deciding, and check the facts before signing anything together. Compassion runs deeper here too, and the couples who practice plain honesty come out unusually close. The one caution is falling for someone's potential, because you can't build a life with who somebody might become. Choose the current version, every day.

headline: Shared money wants sunlight and signatures
body: Neptune is spending years in your 8th house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, debts, beds, secrets. Joint finances are where the blur collects under this transit: who owes what gets vague, agreements live in memory rather than on paper, and generosity slides into confusion nobody meant to cause. Keep it simple and visible. Put every shared arrangement in writing, even with family, and try not to lend or borrow inside friendships, because this transit turns favors into resentments quietly. The deeper pull of these years is inward: therapy, honest self-examination, and the intimacy of letting someone see what you usually manage alone all do their best work now. The one caution is trusting vibes with money. Trust people with your feelings and documents with your finances.

headline: Doubt is doing you a favor
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger picture: travel, study, belief, everything past your zip code. The big answers go soft here. The philosophy that used to explain everything stops covering the cases in front of you, and you may find yourself unsure of things you'd have defended loudly five years ago. You're allowed to not know for a while; it's the honest position and the useful one. Read widely and strangely, take the trip that has no agenda, sit in traditions that aren't yours and see what they see. Just don't hand the confusion to the first teacher who claims to have the whole map, because certainty for sale is this transit's oldest trap. The belief that survives these years is the kind you keep.

headline: You are more than your job title
body: Neptune is spending years in your 10th house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. The question under the job during these years is purpose, and it doesn't ask politely: the title you worked for can go strangely weightless in your hands, and you may wonder what any of it is for. That doubt isn't failure, it's navigation. Follow it toward work that helps someone, because service is what feels solid under this transit, and the roles that photograph well but mean nothing will quietly lose their color. Take your time; callings form slowly. The one caution is dissolving your ambition entirely while you wait for a sign, since the bills continue regardless. Keep the day job while the calling develops.

headline: The real friends survive clear sight
body: Neptune is spending a long stretch of years in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, the causes you show up for. Idealism colors the social world now. Causes promise everything, new friends arrive glowing, and you may read a group as the family you always wanted before you've seen how it treats anyone. Join groups and causes anyway; this transit can bring the kindest, strangest, most creative people of your life. Just check that the group deals in reality, and notice who does the dishes after the meeting, because that tells you more than the mission statement. And don't volunteer to be the one who always sacrifices; being endlessly available isn't what friendship asks. Some disappointment is built into these years, and it's survivable. Whoever's left once you see clearly, keep.

headline: Rest is the whole assignment now
body: Neptune is spending years in your 12th house, staying a long while in the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This is Neptune's home territory, and it turns the volume of ordinary life down. The calendar may clear before a new direction appears, dreams get vivid and strangely specific, and you may crave more time alone than the people around you understand. Give yourself that time without apologizing for it. Prayer, meditation, therapy, long swims, anything that reaches under the surface does double work during these years, and old griefs may surface on their own schedule so they can finally leave. The one caution is disappearing entirely, because solitude heals and isolation doesn't, and the line between them is one returned phone call. Keep a witness. Let the quiet work.

headline: For a few months, the mirror sharpens
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles who you are: your face, your name, the self you lead with. Retrograde thins the veil here, and for a while you can see yourself with unusual clarity: which parts of your current identity are actually yours, and which ones you drifted into because someone needed you to. Use the window. Revisit the version of you that got shelved a few years back, notice where you've been playing a character, and quietly retire what doesn't fit. Someone who knew an earlier you may reappear and show you, by contrast, how much has changed. This review isn't a setback and you're not regressing; you're editing. Write down what you see; when the soft focus returns, you'll be glad you did.

headline: Run the real numbers this season
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: income, possessions, your sense of what you're worth. For a few months the financial blur sharpens, and things you took on faith become checkable: the subscription quietly renewing, the deal that was vaguer than you admitted, the rate you've been charging because you were afraid to name the real one. This is the review window, so use it literally. Open the statements, reread the agreement, cancel what you forgot you were paying for, and renegotiate the number that has been wrong for a while. A past source of income can resurface too, and it deserves a second look. Just don't launch a brand new venture yet; this pass is for repair. Clean books first, new bets later.

headline: Old misunderstandings are suddenly solvable
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: texts, errands, siblings, the daily back and forth. The blur that has been sitting over your everyday communication thins for a while, and conversations that kept going sideways start making sense: you can finally see what they actually meant, and what you actually said. Use the clarity to repair. Go back to the misunderstanding with the sibling or the neighbor, say what you meant plainly this time, and put the recurring plans in writing while everyone can see straight. A half-finished writing project from a while back may call to you again, and this is exactly the season to revise it. A second pass isn't a setback in this house; it's how anything here gets finished.

headline: The past visits; look at it kindly
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 4th house, the part of your chart that handles home, family, and everything you come from. The soft filter that has been sitting over your history lifts a little, and for a few months you can see the family story with unusual accuracy: what actually happened, who actually did what, which parts of the myth were decoration. That clarity is a gift if you use it gently. Revisit the old conversation that never resolved, ask the parent the question you've been carrying, while you can, and fix the thing in the house you've been pretending not to see, the leak, the paperwork, the spare key. Relatives from the past may drift back through. None of this means going backward; you're renovating the foundation, and you can't renovate what you refuse to look at.

headline: See who you have been dating
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 5th house, the part of your chart that handles fun: romance, art, play, the things you do purely for joy. For a while the romantic soft focus sharpens, and you can see who you've actually been dating rather than who you cast them as. Sometimes that's a relief, because the real person turns out better than the fantasy; sometimes it's information you need. Either way, look while the looking is good. An old flame may resurface during these months, and the point isn't reunion, it's understanding what that chapter was teaching you. Creative work thrives on revision now, so go back into the drafts, the demos, the half-painted canvas. Refine rather than launch. Second passes aren't setbacks in this house; every good story gets rewritten at least once.

headline: Rebuild the routine that actually helps
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 6th house, the part of your chart that handles the daily grind: routines, work, health. For a few months the vagueness around your habits thins, and you can finally see which parts of your routine are care and which are habit wearing a wellness costume. Review all of it: the supplements you can't explain, the schedule that exhausts you by Wednesday, the symptom you've been narrating around rather than checking. Book the follow-up, get the second opinion, and bring back the one health practice from a few years ago that actually worked, because returning to it isn't failure, it's following the evidence. At work, tidy the backlog before saying yes to anything new. A second pass through your days isn't a setback. It's maintenance, and maintenance is what this house respects.

headline: See the person, not the potential
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 7th house, the part of your chart that handles the other person: your partner, your best friend, the one across the table. The guesswork that close relationships have been running on clears for a while, and you can see the actual person: what they give, what they can't, what you've been supplying with imagination. Use the window to renegotiate rather than to prosecute. Say the resentment that went quiet, ask the question you've been answering for them, and redo the agreement both of you privately stopped honoring. Someone from a past relationship may reappear during these months; treat it as a chance to understand the pattern, not an invitation to repeat it. Seeing clearly isn't the end of the romance. It's the beginning of the real one.

headline: Untangle the money nobody discusses
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 8th house, the part of your chart that handles what you share: money, debts, beds, secrets. For a few months the murk around joint finances thins, and arrangements that lived on assumption become visible: the debt with no schedule, the account nobody watches, the agreement each of you remembers differently. This is the season to untangle it. Pull the statements, name the numbers out loud, put the understanding in writing, and close the loan between friends that has been quietly souring. Old secrets can surface now too, yours or someone else's, and the honest conversation costs less than the upkeep of hiding. Reviewing what you share isn't a step backward; entanglements only loosen when someone looks directly at them. Look now, while looking is easy.

headline: Reread the beliefs you inherited
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 9th house, the part of your chart that handles the bigger picture: travel, study, belief, everything past your zip code. For a while, the haze around what you believe thins, and you can examine your own convictions like objects on a table: which ones you chose, which ones you absorbed, which ones you've been repeating out of loyalty rather than agreement. This is a reviewing season, not a converting one, so be wary of any teacher or program that wants a commitment right now. Go back to the book that changed you and see if it survives rereading. Revisit the place, or the plan for the place, that once meant everything. Some beliefs will pass the second reading and become truly yours. The ones that don't were borrowed anyway.

headline: Check the map before climbing further
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 10th house, the part of your chart that handles your name in the world: career, reputation, the work people know you for. The question of purpose that has been humming under your job gets briefly audible, and you can hear your own answer with unusual clarity: which parts of this career are calling, which parts are costume, and which goal you've been climbing toward mostly because it was already on the calendar. Use the window to review rather than resign. Update the resume, reread the five year plan and see if you recognize its author, and talk to someone who left the path you're on. A former colleague may resurface with something worth hearing. Course corrections made now, quietly and on paper, save loud ones later.

headline: Count who actually shows up
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 11th house, the part of your chart that handles your people: friends, groups, the causes you show up for. The glow around your social world dims to something more accurate for a while, and you can see the difference between the community you imagined and the one you have: who checks in, who only appears when they need something, which cause spends its energy on the mission and which one spends it on the drama. Use the clarity kindly. Reconnect with the old friend the busy years pushed out of frame, and quietly step back from the group that runs on your unpaid labor. A friendship that faded may circle back now, and this time you'll see it accurately. Fewer, truer people isn't a loss. It's the point.

headline: Your dreams are being unusually direct
body: Neptune is retrograde for several months in your 12th house, the part of your chart that handles the unconscious: solitude, secrets, rest, the endings that make beginnings possible. This is Neptune's own territory, and retrograde here works like a tide going out: things you sank years ago become visible on the sand, old griefs, old versions of you, the thing you never told anyone. For a few months your inner life is unusually legible, so give it attention on purpose. Keep the notebook by the bed, because the dreams get specific now. Take the retreat, book the therapy intensive, finish the mourning you had to pause in order to keep functioning. Nothing surfacing here has come to haunt you; it has come to leave, and it can only leave once it's been seen. Witness it, thank it, and travel lighter.

headline: The rebuild goes all the way down.
body: Pluto is staying a long while in your 1st house, the part of your chart that handles who you are: your body, your presence, the way you run your own life. Change here is slow and it doesn't reverse. Over these years the urge to manage everything gets louder before it gets examined, and that urge is the material: it points straight at whatever you've been holding down. Old versions of you stop fitting, and people who knew you before will say you seem different, because you are. Use the years for anything that gets underneath: therapy, writing, the conversations you've been avoiding with yourself. The one caution is control, because gripping tighter only delays what's already moving. Let the outgrown version go; what replaces it runs on real power, not effort.

headline: Your worth was never the number.
body: Pluto is staying a long while in your 2nd house, the part of your chart that handles what's yours: income, possessions, your sense of what you're worth. Over these years the way you earn changes at the root. A leaner stretch can come first, and it's a phase, not a sentence: what funds the next part of your life usually shows up after you stop propping up the old way. Possessions shift meaning too, and you may find yourself giving away things you once thought you couldn't live without. Use the years to ask where your sense of worth actually comes from, because whatever you've attached it to gets tested here. The one caution is clinging, since keeping a dying arrangement alive costs more than releasing it. What survives these years was really yours.

headline: The polite version stops working.
body: Pluto is staying a long while in your 3rd house, the part of your chart that handles your words: conversations, siblings, the ideas you repeat without checking. Over these years your thinking turns searching.
